SUSPECTED DOUBLE COUNT, P5861 vs P4778 (batch_01) — recommend human adjudication, not unilateral deletion. Both rows describe an identical corridor: Gao'an-Xinyu, Jiangxi, operating, StartYear1/Month1 = 2010-12 (identical on both), Capacity = 1.00 bcm/y (identical on both). P5861 attributes this to 'West-East Gas Pipeline 2, XinYu Branch' with Operator/Owner = PipeChina 100%; P4778 attributes it to 'Jiangxi Natural Gas Pipeline Network, Phase I' with Operator/Owner = a JV (Jiangxi Natural Gas Group 54% / PipeChina 46%), sourced from an official 2025 SSE bond disclosure and a 2014 Jiangxi provincial gas-development-plan PDF (赣发改规划[2014]325号).

Evidence favoring P4778's framing as the correct one and P5861 as a misattributed duplicate:
(1) The Jiangxi provincial plan PDF (img9.qianzhan.com/policy/202307/14/20230714-d7d735aa6fb9eae9.pdf, already cited on P4778; hand-verified via pdftotext -layout since url_verifier's extraction missed the CJK text — 'ok:true' by inspection) explicitly names '高安-新余' (Gao'an-Xinyu) as ONE OF SIX named trunk lines making up the Jiangxi provincial gas network's 870 km Phase I (built ~2009-2010), and states this Phase I network's gas source is 川气东送 (Sichuan-East Gas Transmission / ChuanQi Dongsong) — NOT West-East Gas Pipeline 2. The same document separately describes a Phase II network (98 km, built to receive WEP2/WEP3 gas) whose named sections are Ji'an/Ganzhou/Anyi/Yichun/Pingxiang — no Gao'an-Xinyu segment.
(2) The NDRC's own official table of PipeChina's cross-province gas pipelines (ndrc.gov.cn/xxgk/zcfb/tz/202312/P020231205363278799826.pdf, hand-verified via pdftotext) lists WEP2's Jiangxi-area named branch as '南昌-上海支干线' (Nanchang-Shanghai) only — no Gao'an-Xinyu branch appears among WEP2's officially listed branches anywhere in this table.
(3) A dedicated table of small WEP2-related segment lengths within Jiangxi, in the same provincial-plan PDF (p.16 area, e.g. '西二线新余-新余 3.9km', '西二线九江-九江 9km'), lists many short city-gate/valve-station connector segments but no 69.21 km Gao'an-Xinyu line.
(4) No independent source anywhere (7+ targeted Chinese-language searches, incl. exact-phrase '新余支线' 西气东输 and '高安至新余'输气管道) uses the term 'West-East Gas Pipeline 2 Xinyu Branch' or otherwise corroborates it as a named entity.
(5) The wiki's sole citation for P5861 (candidate_urls, all 5 owed-on-row wiki_attributions) is one single URL, http://ynb.nea.gov.cn/front/article/107157.html — confirmed HTTP 404 in this batch's harvest screen, AND its Wayback CDX record shows the only-ever capture (2025-04-30) was itself already a 404, so the original content is permanently unrecoverable and cannot be checked.
(6) 'ynb' most likely denotes Yichun (宜春) — the prefecture-level city that administers Gao'an — consistent with this being a mis-filed citation for the Jiangxi provincial Gao'an-Xinyu trunk rather than a genuine WEP2-branch source.

Caveat / what would overturn this: a document that explicitly names 'Xinyu Branch' as a WEP2-family asset (none found despite the search effort above), or evidence the Jiangxi Phase I network was itself later absorbed/rebranded as a WEP2 branch post-2010.
